# SC-07: Exfiltration of model weights or large sensitive datasets

<!-- generated by tools/build_results.py from manifest.json, Lean sources and evidence files; edit those, not this file -->

_Generated from manifest.json._

**Bad event:** A sandboxed job sends more than its byte quota off-host, reaches a non-allowlisted destination, or keeps sending after a trusted HALT. Quantitatively (SC07Exfil): exfiltrating S information bits through a q-bit/window quota needs ≥ ⌈S/q⌉ traffic windows; with independent per-window catch probability ≥ p·r and HALT on catch, completion before catch ≤ (1−pr)^⌈S/q⌉; expected leaked bits ≤ q/(pr).

**Adversary:** Benign workloads only in the evidence run (uploads above/below quota, a non-allowlisted destination); no evasion, covert or timing channels.

**Scope:** Single host, network namespaces + nftables quota/allowlist at a trusted gateway namespace, plain TCP. Not: covert/timing channels (SC-01/02/04), DNS, other protocols, adversarial workloads, weight-scale data volumes.

**Refutation (what would show the claim wrong):** Sink-observed bytes above quota + tolerance, any bytes at a non-allowlisted sink, or bytes after HALT beyond tolerance (PREREG-SC07-EGRESSQ-v1).

**Families:** F1, F3, F5
